Fooling Our Children’s Children: Lying About the Medical Marijuana Movement;
Is There Any Difference Between The Drug Czar and A Crackpot?

(Ed. note: A reader was kind enough send me an email with the header "You’ve been lied about again." He did this to bring to my attention an Oregon based prohibitionist propaganda site called For Our Children’s Children.

It is sponsored by a tax-deductible educational foundation by that name. Near the top of its home page http://www.focc.org:/index.html it says, "No glitz, ... just factual information and perspectives, built on solid foundations." The web master even likes to cite scripture, but apparently he has overlooked the 9th Commandment, "Thou shall not give false witness against thy neighbor."

As so often happens, this coincided with other articles, and reminded me of two of the odder characteristics of the prohibitionist movement.

First, at the grassroots level they really don’t have a clue as to what we are really saying. Consequently, they demonize us and then assume that they don’t need to know. They are not just "close-minded." They have a completely closed information system. They only read prohibitionist sources, and they believe whatever they are told, however absurd it may be. This is more demonology than ideology. It keeps the circuit closed.

By contrast, the anti-prohibitionist movement in general – and this site in particular – tries to present the prohibitionist position at every opportunity. In the end, this will work greatly to our advantage.

Second, there is remarkably little difference between the most extreme positions and the "mainstream" or official US government positions. Generally, I think that it is unfair to cite an extremist position as typical, and then use that as the target of a rebuttal. All movements have their crackpots. Rebutting them really proves nothing except that you can beat up on the rhetorically-challenged.

But among prohibitionists the official voices differ little from what in any other movement would be considered an extremist position.

If you are prohibitionist, you can never be too extreme to be mainstream.

Moreover, the media will never object. Indeed, they may seek you out, as you can see at the bottom of the page at the links to other attacks on the medical marijuana movement from "official" sources.

Below are some excerpts from various pages on the For Our Children's Children site. They give you the flavor, but you really must visit the site at http://www.focc.org:/index.html to appreciate it fully.

For clarity’s sake I have put all of the excerpts in italics, but otherwise I have tried to preserve the "look and feel" of the page.

Because, once you have hundreds of thousands of people using marijuana medically, under medical supervision, the whole scam is going to be blown. I mean what we know is that marijuana prohibition is the greatest fraud ever perpetrated on the American people...

The consensus here is that medical marijuana is our strongest suit. It is our point of leverage which will move us toward the legalization of marijuana for personal use, and in that process we will begin to break down the power of the narcocracy to wage a war of terror over things.

And so I think that we have the beginning with medical marijuana, then the legalization of personal use, and then we are in a position to take on the narcocracy on all of its abuses across the board, including obviously LSD and the psychedelics and the inhumane treatment of hard drug addicts as well.") From reading their own words, it is obvious they have no credibility! They are hiding behind the terminally ill, those who truly suffer, feigning illnesses to justify their plan to legalize, first, marijuana, then all drugs.

The people leading this legalization charge, the members of N.O.R.M.L., National Organization for the Reform of Marijuana Laws - - - their current leader admits that using medical marijuana is a "scam" with the long term goal of legalizing all drugs!

Is this what you want?
